text:
Grab's deliveries GMV grew faster in FY2025 than in FY2024.

- FY2024: Deliveries GMV rose 13%, from $10.37 billion (2023) to $11.72 billion [Grab, FY2024, p.140].

So FY2025's growth rate (21%) was notably higher than FY2024's (13%) — a difference of 8 percentage points.
